card.name: Leading digit before a comma
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number, usually 1 or 5, right before a comma in a thousands group or a reference list. It appears in populations, dose amounts, sizes and citations.

modes.label: Thousands separator
modes.description: A leading digit followed by a comma in a large number such as a population, dose or measurement.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: The first digit of a unit count in a dosing table.
modes.example: Intermittent Intravenous Injection Initial Dose 10,000 Units Subsequent Doses <<5>>,000 to 10

modes.label: Citation lists
modes.description: A digit in a bracketed or parenthesized reference list, followed by a comma.
modes.example: is related to use of these drugs (<<1>>,2)

card.writes: It promotes comma-plus-punctuation tokens, which suggests it pushes the output toward a comma after the digit.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number when a comma is expected next, as in 1,000 or a reference list like (1,2).
